role: the two must-do items of docs/paper-outline.md that could still change a headline number: training-seed variance for the specialists, and a second hosted model for the retrieval results
claim: The main comparison of the paper (outline table T3) sets the best-equipped specialist against the general model with retrieval on five label sets. Each specialist row is one training seed, and every retrieval row is one model, Gemma 4 31B, in one run. This protocol adds two training seeds per specialist, a second hosted model with retrieval on all five label sets, and a repeat of the Gemma retrieval run on the three synthetic domains to measure run-to-run variation of a hosted model at temperature 0. Written before any of these models was trained or any of these requests was sent.

part_1_seeds.specialist: the 150M Ettin encoder, Program 2 recipe at learning rate 1e-4, on each domain's training data exactly as in sections 3.29/3.30 (banking77, massive, clinc150), 3.35 (banking77_oos) and 3.34 (multidogo, current message only)
part_1_seeds.existing_seed: the models already reported count as the first seed
part_1_seeds.rows: for each seed: session success with the softmax threshold and with the dev-selected scope detector (synthetic domains; for bankingoos both the 'id' and 'ood' session sets), and conversation success and label accuracy (multidogo); the mean and range over the three seeds

part_2_second_model.model: qwen3.5-27b on its workflow v4 host (Alibaba)
part_2_second_model.why_this_model: a different family from Gemma 4 31B, of similar size, the second-best zero-shot model of the ladder on banking and CLINC150

runs.banking77, massive, clinc150: retrieval from the full training set, as section 3.29
runs.banking77_oos: zero-shot and retrieval on both session sets, as section 3.35

part_3_repeat.what: the Gemma 4 31B full-training-set retrieval run of section 3.29 sent again, unchanged, on the three synthetic domains
part_3_repeat.rows: session success of the repeat against the original, and the share of turns whose answer changed

readout_stated_in_advance: the headline comparison stands if, for each domain, the ordering of the best-equipped specialist and the retrieval-prompted general model is the same for both hosted models and holds across the three specialist seeds
